long_biography.plain_text:
Gulbakhor Burkhanovna Ismailova spent her working life in medicine, practising as a gynaecologist in Tashkent before retirement. She graduated with honours from Tashkent Medical Institute after pursuing an early ambition to become a doctor, then built her career in the Uzbek capital.

Her wider financial profile came from being named as a beneficiary of family trusts created through transfers involving her brother, industrialist Alisher Usmanov. Ismailova later signed deeds excluding her from future benefits and described the decision as final and irreversible. Her enduring professional record remains the medical career she pursued in Uzbekistan.
